objects.description: Represents pinhole camera intrinsic parameters: focal lengths (fx, fy), principal point (cx, cy), and optionally image dimensions (width, height). Immutable after construction; accessors provide read-only values. Useful for camera calibration and projection computations. Width/height default to -1 if unspecified.

functions.name: CameraIntrinsics::fx
functions.description: Returns the lens focal length along the x-axis in pixels stored in this CameraIntrinsics instance. Use to retrieve the intrinsic parameter fx previously provided at construction.
requirements: The CameraIntrinsics object must have been properly constructed before calling.
No arguments; callable on a const instance.
Returned value is whatever was set at construction; no range constraints are enforced by this function.

functions.description: Returns the lens focal length along the y-axis in pixels stored in this CameraIntrinsics instance. Use to retrieve the intrinsic parameter fy previously provided at construction.
requirements: The CameraIntrinsics object must have been properly constructed before calling.

Returned value is whatever was set at construction; no range constraints are enforced by this function.

functions.name: CameraIntrinsics::cx
functions.description: Returns the principal point x-coordinate (in pixels) stored in this CameraIntrinsics instance. Use to retrieve the intrinsic parameter cx previously provided at construction.
requirements: The CameraIntrinsics object must have been properly constructed before calling.
No arguments; callable on a const instance.
Returned value is whatever was set at construction; no range constraints are enforced by this function.

requirements: The CameraIntrinsics object must have been properly constructed before calling.
No arguments; callable on a const instance.

functions.name: CameraIntrinsics::width
functions.description: Returns the image width in pixels stored in this CameraIntrinsics instance. If constructed without explicit width, this may be -1 to indicate unknown.
requirements: The CameraIntrinsics object must have been properly constructed before calling.
No arguments; callable on a const instance.
Callers should handle the possibility of a sentinel value (-1) indicating unspecified width.

requirements: The CameraIntrinsics object must have been properly constructed before calling.

functions.name: mediapipe::Demangle
functions.description: Demangles a C++ mangled symbol name to a human-readable form. On platforms where __cxa_demangle is available and demangling succeeds, returns the demangled name; otherwise returns the input string unchanged. Use to convert ABI-mangled identifiers (e.g., _Z3bazifdPv) into readable C++ signatures for logging or diagnostics.
requirements: mangled must be a non-null pointer to a null-terminated C string.
Safe to pass already-demangled or plain names; the function will return the input unchanged if not mangled or if demangling is unavailable/fails.
No ownership transfer: the function does not retain or free the input string.
Behavior depends on platform/compiler support for __cxa_demangle; callers should not rely on demangling being available.
On allocation failure while constructing the return value, standard library exceptions (e.g., std::bad_alloc) may propagate.

data_types.description: A string formatted as a C++ ABI-mangled name (e.g., Itanium ABI). Typical examples look like _Z3fooi, _ZN3ns3FooEv, etc. It is a null-terminated byte string that may contain ASCII punctuation, digits, and letters, and should conform to the mangling rules so that demanglers can reconstruct readable C++ identifiers and signatures.

A generic null-terminated text string encoded as ASCII or UTF-8. May be any sequence of bytes valid as UTF-8 (or plain ASCII), including ordinary words, already-demangled names, or arbitrary text; used here because the function accepts any C string and returns it unchanged if not a valid mangled symbol.

import random
import string
from typing import List, Tuple

# This generator focuses on producing valid Itanium C++ ABI-mangled names
# to exercise mediapipe::Demangle. It also occasionally returns already
# demangled or plain identifiers, and edge-like but valid variations to
# cover different demangler code paths. Outputs are always ASCII bytes
# and <= 4096 bytes.

# References (mental model, not imported):
# - Function: _Z <name> <type>...
# - Nested: _ZN <len name>+ E <type>...
# - Overload: varies by argument types encodings (i, j, l, f, d, v, P, R, K, etc.)
# - Templates: I <args> E
# - Operators: nw, dl, pl, mi, ml, dv, eq, ne, lt, gt, le, ge, call, idx, cv, etc.
# - Constructors/Destructors: C1/C2/D1/D2 in nested contexts
# - Special forms: _ZTV, _ZTI, _ZTS for vtable, typeinfo, typeinfo name

MAX_BYTES = 4096

# Primitive type encodings under Itanium ABI
PRIMS = [
    'v',  # void
    'b',  # bool
    'c',  # char
    'a',  # signed char
    'h',  # unsigned char
    's',  # short
    't',  # unsigned short
    'i',  # int
    'j',  # unsigned int
    'l',  # long
    'm',  # unsigned long
    'x',  # long long
    'y',  # unsigned long long
    'n',  # __int128
    'o',  # unsigned __int128
    'f',  # float
    'd',  # double
    'e',  # long double
]

QUALS = ['K', 'V', 'r']  # const, volatile, restrict (r often unused but allowed)
REFS = ['R', 'O']        # lvalue ref, rvalue ref
PTR = 'P'                # pointer

# A small set of builtin operator encodings
OPERATORS = [
    'nw', 'na', 'dl', 'da',  # new/delete
    'ps', 'ng', 'de',        # unary +, -, * (dereference)
    'pl', 'mi', 'ml', 'dv', 'rm',  # + - * / %
    'an', 'or', 'eo',        # & | ^
    'aS',                    # operator=
    'eq', 'ne', 'lt', 'gt', 'le', 'ge',
    'ls', 'rs',              # << >>
    'ad', 'co',              # & (address), ~
    'nt', 'aa', 'oo',        # ! && ||
    'cm', 'pm', 'pt', 'ix',  # , pointer-to-member, ->*, []
    'cl',                    # ()
]

IDENT_CHARS = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + '_'


def _rand_ident(rng: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=12) -> str:
    # Ensure first char is not a digit to be realistic for C++ identifiers
    first_pool = string.ascii_letters + '_'
    rest_pool = IDENT_CHARS
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    if n <= 0:
        n = 1
    s = rng.choice(first_pool)
    for _ in range(n - 1):
        s += rng.choice(rest_pool)
    return s


def _encode_len_name(name: str) -> str:
    return f"{len(name)}{name}"


def _rand_namespace_path(rng: random.Random, depth_range=(1, 3)) -> List[str]:
    depth = rng.randint(*depth_range)
    # Include common namespace-like names
    pool = [
        'std', 'absl', 'mediapipe', 'google', 'foo', 'bar', 'baz', 'ns', 'detail', 'internal'
    ]
    path = []
    for i in range(depth):
        if rng.random() < 0.6:
            path.append(rng.choice(pool))
        else:
            path.append(_rand_ident(rng))
    return path


def _rand_template_args(rng: random.Random, max_args=3) -> str:
    # Very simplified template argument list mixing types and integral constants
    n = rng.randint(1, max_args)
    args = []
    for _ in range(n):
        if rng.random() < 0.7:
            args.append(_rand_type(rng))
        else:
            # integral non-type template param: Li<digits>E
            val = rng.randint(-5, 100)
            if val < 0:
                args.append(f"Ln{abs(val)}E")
            else:
                args.append(f"Li{val}E")
    return 'I' + ''.join(args) + 'E'


def _rand_name_maybe_template(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    base = _rand_ident(rng)
    if rng.random() < 0.4:
        return _encode_len_name(base) + _rand_template_args(rng)
    else:
        return _encode_len_name(base)


def _rand_nested_name(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # _ZN <components> E
    parts = []
    # Optionally start with operator or ctor/dtor special names
    if rng.random() < 0.15:
        op = rng.choice(OPERATORS)
        parts.append(f"{len(op)}{op}")
    path = _rand_namespace_path(rng, (1, 3))
    for p in path:
        parts.append(_encode_len_name(p))
    # Class/struct with optional template
    if rng.random() < 0.8:
        parts.append(_rand_name_maybe_template(rng))
    # Member or function name
    if rng.random() < 0.9:
        # 30% ctor/dtor using C1/D1
        if rng.random() < 0.3:
            parts.append('2C1')
        elif rng.random() < 0.1:
            parts.append('2D1')
        else:
            parts.append(_rand_name_maybe_template(rng))
    return '_ZN' + ''.join(parts) + 'E'


def _rand_unqualified_name(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    if rng.random() < 0.2:
        # operator function
        op = rng.choice(OPERATORS)
        return '_Z' + f"{len(op)}{op}"
    else:
        return '_Z' + _encode_len_name(_rand_ident(rng))


def _rand_type(rng: random.Random, depth=0) -> str:
    # Build a type with qualifiers, pointers, references, and primitives
    # Limit recursion depth to keep size bounded
    if depth > 3:
        return rng.choice(PRIMS)

    t = ''
    # Add some qualifiers randomly
    while rng.random() < 0.3:
        t += rng.choice(QUALS)
    # Pointers/references nesting
    while rng.random() < 0.35 and len(t) < 10:
        choice = rng.random()
        if choice < 0.6:
            t += PTR
        elif choice < 0.85:
            t += rng.choice(REFS)
        else:
            t += rng.choice(QUALS)
    # Base type: primitive or nested name
    if rng.random() < 0.75:
        base = rng.choice(PRIMS)
    else:
        # User type: nested name encoding with length prefixes
        # e.g., N3foo3BarE -> we embed as: N <len name> ... E; here we can just reuse nested names
        # For Itanium, a user type in type position uses N ... E or length-encoded unscoped name.
        if rng.random() < 0.6:
            # simple unscoped user type: <len>name
            base = _encode_len_name(_rand_ident(rng))
        else:
            # scoped type: N <...> E
            # We'll build a short nested path as a type name
            names = _rand_namespace_path(rng, (1, 2))
            comp = ''.join(_encode_len_name(n) for n in names)
            base = 'N' + comp + 'E'
        # Maybe template arguments for the last component are already embedded via name length; acceptable for demanglers
    t += base

    # Function types occasionally: F <types> E <ref-qual/except> (simplified)
    if rng.random() < 0.12:
        nargs = rng.randint(0, 4)
        args = ''.join(_rand_type(rng, depth + 1) for _ in range(nargs))
        ret = _rand_type(rng, depth + 1)
        t = 'F' + ret + args + 'E'
    return t


def _rand_args(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Generate argument type list; empty means void
    if rng.random() < 0.1:
        return 'v'
    n = rng.randint(0, 5)
    if n == 0:
        return 'v'
    return ''.join(_rand_type(rng) for _ in range(n))


def _rand_function_encoding(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Either nested or unqualified function name, then argument types
    if rng.random() < 0.6:
        prefix = _rand_nested_name(rng)
    else:
        prefix = _rand_unqualified_name(rng)
    args = _rand_args(rng)
    return prefix + args


def _special_entities(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Vtable, typeinfo, typeinfo name
    choice = rng.choice(['_ZTV', '_ZTI', '_ZTS'])
    # Followed by type name encoding
    if rng.random() < 0.7:
        # scoped type
        names = _rand_namespace_path(rng, (1, 3))
        comp = ''.join(_encode_len_name(n) for n in names)
        tname = 'N' + comp + 'E'
    else:
        tname = _encode_len_name(_rand_ident(rng))
    return choice + tname


def _demangled_examples(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Plain/demangled forms to ensure function also sees non-mangled strings
    samples = [
        'foo(int)',
        'ns::Bar<float>::baz(double, char const*)',
        'std::vector<int>::size() const',
        'operator+(int, int)',
        'mediapipe::CameraIntrinsics::fx() const',
        'main',
    ]
    return rng.choice(samples)


def _edge_valid_cases(rng: random.Random) -> str:
    # Still valid under Itanium but edge-like
    choices = []
    # zero-arg function
    choices.append('_Z3foov')
    # nested with ctor
    choices.append('_ZN3ns33FooC1Ev')
    # operator overload
    choices.append('_Zplii')
    # pointer and refs
    choices.append('_Z3barPKiRf')
    # templates
    choices.append('_ZN3std6vectorIiE4sizeEv')
    # long chain of qualifiers and pointers
    choices.append('_Z7complexPKPKKvi')
    # typeinfo and vtable
    choices.append('_ZTISt6vectorIiE')
    choices.append('_ZTVN3foo3BarE')
    return rng.choice(choices)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)

    # Decide category of output
    p = rng.random()
    if p < 0.65:
        s = _rand_function_encoding(rng)
    elif p < 0.8:
        s = _special_entities(rng)
    elif p < 0.92:
        s = _edge_valid_cases(rng)
    else:
        s = _demangled_examples(rng)

    # Ensure within size limit and ASCII
    b = s.encode('ascii', errors='ignore')
    if len(b) > MAX_BYTES:
        b = b[:MAX_BYTES]
    # Ensure non-empty per FUZZ_PARAM_STR requirement
    if not b:
        b = b'_Z1fv'
    return b

import random
import struct
from typing import List

# This generator produces ASCII/UTF-8 strings intended for mediapipe::Demangle.
# It focuses on valid C++ Itanium ABI mangled names as well as plain/unmangled
# identifiers and edge-case strings. The output is bytes suitable for feeding
# FUZZ_PARAM_STR/FUZZ_PARAM_FILENAME (as file content) and will be null-terminated
# by the C++ std::string c_str() usage in the fuzzer.

_MAX_BYTES = 4096

# Small corpus of known-good mangled names (Itanium ABI) and their rough meanings.
_KNOWN_MANGLED = [
    b"_Z3foov",                 # void foo()
    b"_Z3bari",                 # void bar(int)
    b"_Z3bazifdPv",             # void baz(int,float,double,void*)
    b"_ZN3abc3def5ghiE",        # abc::def::ghi (variable/name)
    b"_ZNSt6vectorIiSaIiEE6resizeEm",  # std::vector<int>::resize(unsigned long)
    b"_ZlsRSoRKSi",             # operator<<(std::ostream&, std::istream const&)
    b"_Z1fPKc",                 # f(char const*)
    b"_Z1fPc",                  # f(char*)
    b"_Z1fRKi",                 # f(int const&)
    b"_ZplRKdS1_",               # operator+(double const&, double const&)
    b"_Z4funcIiEvi",            # template instantiation
    b"_ZSt4moveIRiEONSt16remove_referenceIT_E4typeEOS2_",  # std::move<int&>
    b"_ZNK3Foo3barEi",          # Foo::bar(int) const
]

# Some already-demangled or plain names to ensure passthrough behavior.
_PLAIN_NAMES = [
    b"foo",
    b"bar",
    b"baz",
    b"operator<<",
    b"std::vector<int>::resize",
    b"Foo::bar(int) const",
    b"_not_mangled_but_starts_with_underscore",
]

# Unicode/UTF-8 examples (valid UTF-8):
_UTF8_STRINGS = [
    "προβολή",                 # Greek
    "函数重载",                 # Chinese
    "оператор+",               # Cyrillic
    "emoji_🔥_测试",            # Emoji + mix
    "名前空間::関数",            # Japanese with scope
]

# Helper: Generate a valid Itanium ABI mangled function name with random signature.
# This aims for validity, not full coverage of the ABI.

def _rand_ident(rng: random.Random, min_len=1, max_len=8) -> bytes:
    # identifiers: start with letter or _, then letters/digits/_
    alphabet_first = b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_"
    alphabet_rest = alphabet_first + b"0123456789"
    n = rng.randint(min_len, max_len)
    s = bytes([alphabet_first[rng.randrange(len(alphabet_first))]])
    s += bytes(alphabet_rest[rng.randrange(len(alphabet_rest))] for _ in range(n - 1))
    return s

def _type_code(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # subset of Itanium type codes
    base = [b"v", b"b", b"c", b"a", b"h", b"s", b"t", b"i", b"j", b"l", b"m", b"x", b"y", b"f", b"d", b"e", b"n", b"o", b"P", b"R", b"K", b"S_", b"N"]
    t = rng.choice(base)
    if t == b"P":  # pointer to
        return b"P" + _type_code(rng)
    if t == b"R":  # reference to
        return b"R" + _type_code(rng)
    if t == b"K":  # const qualifier
        return b"K" + _type_code(rng)
    if t == b"S_":  # substitution (use std::)
        return b"S_"
    if t == b"N":  # nested name N <components> E
        # Build a nested name like N3abc3defE
        comps = rng.randint(2, 4)
        parts = []
        for _ in range(comps):
            ident = _rand_ident(rng)
            parts.append(str(len(ident)).encode('ascii') + ident)
        return b"N" + b"".join(parts) + b"E"
    return t

def _make_mangled(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # _Z <name> <args>
    # name: either nested (N...)E or len+ident
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        # simple name
        name = _rand_ident(rng)
        name_enc = str(len(name)).encode('ascii') + name
    else:
        # nested name
        comps = rng.randint(2, 4)
        parts = []
        for _ in range(comps):
            ident = _rand_ident(rng)
            parts.append(str(len(ident)).encode('ascii') + ident)
        name_enc = b"N" + b"".join(parts) + b"E"
    # args
    argc = rng.randint(0, 5)
    if argc == 0:
        args = b"v"  # void
    else:
        args = b"".join(_type_code(rng) for _ in range(argc))
    return b"_Z" + name_enc + args

def _make_template_like(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    # Create a demangled-looking template signature (plain text)
    name = _rand_ident(rng).decode('ascii')
    params_n = rng.randint(1, 3)
    params = []
    base_types = ["int", "float", "double", "char", "std::string", "std::vector<int>"]
    for _ in range(params_n):
        params.append(rng.choice(base_types))
    args_n = rng.randint(0, 3)
    args = []
    arg_types = ["int", "float", "double", "const char*", "void*", "size_t"]
    for _ in range(args_n):
        args.append(rng.choice(arg_types))
    sig = f"{name}<{', '.join(params)}>(" + ", ".join(args) + ")"
    # possibly qualify
    if rng.random() < 0.5:
        ns = _rand_ident(rng).decode('ascii')
        sig = f"{ns}::{sig}"
    return sig.encode('utf-8')

def _edge_cases() -> List[bytes]:
    return [
        b"",                          # empty string
        b" ",                         # single space
        b"::",                        # scope only
        b"_Z",                        # prefix only
        b"_ZN",                       # nested prefix only
        b"_Z1",                       # partial length
        b"_Z3foo",                    # missing args
        b"_Z3fooDv_",                 # unknown type code sequence
        b"(anonymous namespace)::f",  # typical demangler output text
        b"::operator new(unsigned long)",
    ]

def _choose_corpus(rng: random.Random) -> bytes:
    choice = rng.random()
    if choice < 0.25:
        return rng.choice(_KNOWN_MANGLED)
    if choice < 0.50:
        return _make_mangled(rng)
    if choice < 0.65:
        return rng.choice(_PLAIN_NAMES)
    if choice < 0.80:
        return rng.choice(_edge_cases())
    if choice < 0.95:
        return rng.choice([s.encode('utf-8') for s in _UTF8_STRINGS])
    return _make_template_like(rng)

def _maybe_append_suffix(rng: random.Random, base: bytes) -> bytes:
    # Add common symbol suffixes that may appear in linkers/logs.
    suffixes = [b"", b".llvm.12345", b".cold", b".constprop.5", b"@@GLIBCXX_3.4.26"]
    suf = rng.choice(suffixes)
    return base + suf

def _bounded(data: bytes) -> bytes:
    if len(data) > _MAX_BYTES:
        return data[:_MAX_BYTES]
    return data

def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Build a small batch concatenation sometimes to encourage multiple demangles
    # when the harness might split input; but keep it valid standalone as text.
    parts: List[bytes] = []
    count = 1 if rng.random() < 0.6 else rng.randint(2, 5)
    for _ in range(count):
        s = _choose_corpus(rng)
        s = _maybe_append_suffix(rng, s)
        parts.append(s)
    sep = rng.choice([b"\n", b"\0", b" ", b"\t", b"\n\n"])  # still valid text
    out = sep.join(parts)
    # Ensure non-empty (FUZZ_PARAM_STR already promises non-empty, but be safe)
    if not out:
        out = b"_Z3foov"
    # Bound size
    return _bounded(out)
